faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How can I start the 7-day Pro free trial?
faq.a1: Select Pro and click "Start 7-day trial." You get 7 days of Pro access plus 500 base credits after adding a valid payment method. You won't be charged when the trial begins. After the trial, your subscription renews at ¥10/mo or ¥96/yr. To avoid renewal, cancel at least one day before the trial ends.
faq.q2: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
faq.a2: Yes. Cancel anytime from your profile. After cancellation, your subscription will not renew automatically, but you can continue using your current plan and remaining quota until the end of the billing period.
faq.a3: No. Top-up credits never expire — use them anytime. ¥100 = 1000 credits; larger top-ups include bonus credits.
faq.a4: Credits are consumed by AI token usage and tool executions: reading, knowledge-base Q&A, AI writing, video summaries, and Agent tasks all use credits. Different models consume at different rates; auto routing picks the most cost-effective model first.
faq.q5: How are daily activity credits awarded?
faq.a5: You're considered active for the day if you start at least one conversation in the client. The corresponding credits are added to your account on the following day.
